# check.DryPassReturns(handler, TInteger): a PURE handler that errors on
# a negative operand. On the top-level straight line with all-concrete
# arguments the analysis runs the real handler once, so a guaranteed
# runtime error surfaces as a check diagnostic; anywhere reachability is
# conditional — a fn body, a loop body, a branch arm — the dry pass
# stays silent and only the declared result carrier is modelled.
# --- a clean concrete run models the declared return, no diagnostic ---
# --- a guaranteed runtime fault at top level is surfaced ---
